# Email Authentication Checker

> Free SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI checker: paste any domain and get a plain-English report on why your email might be going to spam, with the exact DNS record read and what it means. Nothing uploaded -- your browser queries public DNS directly.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
